# `lobbying_quarterly_profiles`

**Quarterly lobbying income and expense profiles**

Separate reported quarterly income and in-house expenses with source-linked original/amendment decisions and visible unresolved competitors.

**Coverage.** Derived. Explicit retained filing year, native registrant/client scope, quarters, cutoff and source generation. Every row remains labeled incomplete; a complete observed query is not publisher-wide coverage or future amendment closure. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `lobbying_quarterly_profiles.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_id` | `VARCHAR` | Stable identity of the selection rule, exact native registrant/client pair, filing year and quarter. Missing identities remain separate by filing UUID. |
| `scope_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the explicit quarterly selection, including cutoff and source table pins. |
| `registrant_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native LDA registrant identifier; matching names do not merge registrants. |
| `client_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native client.id within this registrant; not an organization identifier shared across firms. |
| `registrant_name` | `VARCHAR` | Registrant name on the selected filing, or an agreed name among unresolved witnesses. |
| `client_name` | `VARCHAR` | Client name on the selected filing, or an agreed name among unresolved witnesses. |
| `filing_period` | `VARCHAR` | Native quarterly period; pre-2008 semiannual records are outside this output. |
| `selection_status` | `VARCHAR` | Selected for an unambiguous original or original/amendment pair; unresolved otherwise. Amount qualification is separate. |
| `selection_reason` | `VARCHAR` | Replayable reason for selection or refusal. Multiple amendments without predecessor links remain unresolved regardless of posting time. |
| `selected_filing_uuid` | `VARCHAR` | One selected original or amendment; null when no effective filing is established. |
| `selected_filing_type` | `VARCHAR` | Native selected type, including termination and no-activity suffixes. No-activity never implies zero money. |
| `selected_source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher document URL from the selected native filing; not a newly fetched document. |
| `income` | `VARCHAR` | Reported registrant income estimate in USD as decimal text, preserving precision. Null never means zero. Never add to client expenses. |
| `income_status` | `VARCHAR` | Reported_estimate, source_null, source_empty, below_threshold_or_zero_unresolved, invalid_amount, unsupported_amount, unsupported_number, both_measures_reported_unresolved or unresolved_selection. |
| `expenses` | `VARCHAR` | Reported in-house expense estimate in USD as decimal text; may include external firm fees. Different accounting methods are not harmonized. |
| `expenses_status` | `VARCHAR` | Amount qualification as for income, or reporting_method_unresolved when an expense estimate has no recognized method. |
| `expenses_method` | `VARCHAR` | Literal selected expense-method spelling. A/a uses LDA definitions; B/b and C/c use different Internal Revenue Code definitions. |
| `termination_date` | `VARCHAR` | Literal selected termination date; a termination report still reports the quarter and is not discarded. |
| `original_income` | `VARCHAR` | Eligible reported income estimate on the unique original before restatement; original literal remains in witnesses_json. |
| `original_expenses` | `VARCHAR` | Eligible reported expense estimate on the unique original before restatement; not added to the amendment. |
| `income_amendment_change` | `VARCHAR` | Exact decimal difference between two eligible reported estimates when a unique amendment replaces a unique original; not an estimate of exact underlying spending. |
| `expenses_amendment_change` | `VARCHAR` | Difference between comparable original and amended expense estimates with the same recognized method; otherwise null. |
| `witnesses_json` | `VARCHAR` | All in-scope native filings, including separate amendments, original values, methods, source document links and postings; amounts serialize as decimal text. |
| `excluded_filing_uuids_json` | `VARCHAR` | Observed filings posted after the declared cutoff, retained as evidence but excluded from the as-of decision. |
| `cutoff` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit aware as-of timestamp applied to publisher posting dates. Later-discovered or unrequested filings may be missing. |
| `source_table_generation` | `VARCHAR` | Exact pinned source generation selected by the caller; not a current-publication claim. |
| `source_table_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Verified SHA-256 of the actual native lobbying_filings.parquet read for this build. |
| `coverage_status` | `VARCHAR` | Always incomplete_retained_population: a declared retained snapshot does not prove publisher-wide completeness, absence or future amendment closure. |
| `amount_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Always reported_estimate_usd. Source amounts are good-faith estimates, usually rounded to nearest 10000 USD when at least 5000 USD; no exact-spending claim. |
| `overlap_policy` | `VARCHAR` | Keep income and in-house expenses separate because expenses may include fees reported separately as firm income. No combined national total. |
| `selection_policy` | `VARCHAR` | Versioned interpretation rule, lda-quarterly-selection/1. |
| `selection_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact replayable selection control. |
| `filing_year` | `INTEGER` | Declared reporting calendar year, starting with quarterly reporting in 2008. |
| `filing_count` | `INTEGER` | Distinct retained native filings for this pair and quarter, including observed filings after cutoff. |
| `amendment_count` | `INTEGER` | Recognized amendments at or before cutoff; no chain is invented between multiple amendments. |
| `period_start` | `DATE` | First calendar day of the declared quarter, not the acquisition or posting date. |
| `period_end` | `DATE` | Last calendar day of the declared quarter; no annual amount is allocated to quarters. |
